facts.text: I have a spot on my scalp.
I came in for a routine checkup. Nothing in particular has been bothering me.
I keep an active lifestyle: I go jogging and I do gardening.
I spend my mornings in the park and my afternoons in my garden.
I've been retired since I was 50.
I haven't had any other general symptoms.
I don't have any significant medical problems.

findings.name: skin examination
findings.result: A single rough-textured lesion on the scalp, approximately 1 cm in diameter; slightly erythematous with a scaly surface.

findings.name: biopsy of the scalp lesion
findings.result: Histopathology shows atypical keratinocytes confined to the epidermis, consistent with actinic keratosis.
